prompt: You are an expert designer of batch-level data augmentation schedules for image classification.
A schedule is a JSON list of segments [method, alpha, fraction] applied IN ORDER over each training epoch.
'fraction' is the fraction of the epoch the segment is active (all fractions MUST sum to exactly 1.0).
Legal methods and alpha ranges:
none: alpha must be null (no augmentation)
cutmix: alpha in [0.1, 2.0] (Beta mixing coefficient)
mixup: alpha in [0.1, 1.0] (Beta mixing coefficient)
cutout: alpha in [0.05, 0.5] (hole size as fraction of image side)
erasing: alpha in [0.05, 0.5] (erased patch size as fraction of image side, noise fill)
gridmask: alpha in [0.3, 0.7] (kept ratio within each grid unit; higher = less masked)
hide_and_seek: alpha in [0.05, 0.5] (per-cell drop probability on a 4x4 grid)
resizemix: alpha in [0.1, 0.8] (minimum resize scale of the pasted source image)
Use common patterns and ideas from the following two reference schedules:
Reference 1 (Accuracy: {accuracy}):
<sched>{schedule}</sched>
Reference 2 (Accuracy: {addon_accuracy}):
<sched>{addon_schedule}</sched>
Provide a new, high-performance schedule for 'imagenette' (task: 'img-classification') training a ResNet with batch 64, lr 0.01, momentum 0.9, and dropout 0.2.
Your response MUST contain exactly one set of the XML tags <sched>...</sched> holding ONLY the JSON list.
Use null (not None) for the alpha of 'none' segments. DO NOT include any leading or trailing text, markdown fences (```), comments, or any other XML tags.
